rationale: Same trainer family as #714, but with new set_ret_5d_zscore_60d feature in the curated set and widened day_gate_blend search [0.20, 0.95]. Default blend=0.5 over-compresses now that the feature itself encodes regime — train mode should hunt the 0.75-0.95 sweet spot and prefer day_gate_max_depth=2 (the new feature is dominant; deeper trees overfit ~120 unique training dates).
